## Terms

### Data Analysis

- **Data Analysis** · self — Data analysis is the process of inspecting, cleansing, transforming and modeling data to discover useful information, inform conclusions and support decision-making; it spans many techniques under many names across business, science and social science. (high confidence) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_analysis
